author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys, today I'll present to you another map that I've been working on for the past few days. It's a unique type of DTM, and is unlike any other map. The map features four teams, with a single monument, that all four teams will be racing for. This means that nobody camps, nobody plays defense, and it requires extreme teamwork in order to break the monument before the other three teams. It also has a pit of lava under the map, that careless players could fall into, hence the name Pit of Death. Here are some images to help clear things up:





Full album: http://imgur.com/a/btZ5T
Map download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/k3oms66ya628bvr/PitOfDeath.zip
YAML File (Use this instead of the one in the download): http://pastebin.com/V8JhEJrp
YAML File for DTM: http://pastebin.com/VdrmgjJZ

Oh, and here's the loadout:
